gaps.existing_capability: Exact evaluation and bounded best-of-restarts search.
gaps.missing_capability: A portfolio-wide exact solver/certificate below Q=1.
gaps.why_not_duplicate: Exact objective values and local certificates do not enumerate all portfolios.

gaps.existing_capability: Frozen candidate-set constructors support 5/10/20: B649_CANDIDATE_SET_LOW_OVERLAP_V1, B649_CANDIDATE_SET_EXPOSURE_BALANCED_V1, B649_CANDIDATE_SET_HYBRID_DIVERSITY_V1
gaps.missing_capability: Native 2/3 allocation with its own correctness evidence.
gaps.why_not_duplicate: Current guards reject low k; truncating a 5-ticket result changes the contract.

gaps.existing_capability: All requested k have fresh synthetic comparisons; selected native rungs have sealed exact Q.
gaps.missing_capability: Native Q for supported but unmeasured method/k cells and candidate-pool geometry cases.
gaps.why_not_duplicate: A synthetic rule/candidate measurement is not native uniform winning-space evidence.

gaps.existing_capability: Complete radius-1 number-exchange scans and ascent.
gaps.why_not_duplicate: Iterating radius 1 cannot certify or escape every radius-2 plateau; whole-ticket sampled swaps use a different unit.

gaps.existing_capability: Sidon enforces pairwise overlap <=1; coverage optimizers only require distinct tickets.
gaps.missing_capability: Coverage optimization subject to an explicit hard overlap/exposure constraint.
gaps.why_not_duplicate: Greedy overlap preferences and descriptive geometry do not constrain the coverage search feasible set.

gaps.existing_capability: Uniform at-least-one-ticket coverage and frozen lexicographic geometry objectives.
gaps.missing_capability: A formally defined expected-hit utility objective and verified optimizer for it.
gaps.why_not_duplicate: Coverage is a union probability; it is not a utility or payout expectation. Define the contract before implementation.

branch_6.restriction: Consume these metrics; no synthetic/native or geometry/Q pooling.

status_semantics.NOT_RUN: The implementation is supported but no semantically matching native exact evidence was reused or executed.
status_semantics.REUSED_VERIFIED: Pinned existing native exact evidence was re-read and normalized without replaying it.
